en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall man standing with a long line of people of short stature in formal clothing, posed in front of a themed street of small shopfronts labeled as part of a miniature town. Signs above the façades read things like "THE TOWN POST OFFICE," "MIDGET ANALYSTS," and "MIDGET TAILORS." Palm‑like plants are visible in the background. The caption at the bottom of the card reads "FRED ROPER AND HIS WONDER MIDGETS."
